name: files
description: Manage ordinary files and folders in Brightside's configured local, temporary or DLFS-backed roots. Load for local disk files, importing, exporting, organising or editing file content.

content.inline:
# Configured files

Start with the file-roots tool; its live result is the complete file access boundary and explains each root. Use only roots returned by that operation.

Paths are relative to a named root. List or tree to navigate and stat uncertain targets. `create` refuses replacement; `write` creates or overwrites. Move refuses an existing destination; copy and move may cross compatible roots without routing bytes through model context. Report the roots and paths changed.
